basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer | AI-Native Delivery | Python, JavaScript, SQL | Ships to Prod, Not Slides
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer with 13+ years shipping software the customer actually uses. At LumApps I lead technical discovery through production for a global SaaS, owning agent architecture, integrations, and the escalation path when it breaks. Anand Creations is my independent FDE practice: embed, run discovery, build the integrations, ship. Deep across Python, JavaScript, SQL and the messy real-world debugging that comes with client-specific constraints. MBA-trained, spoken at Dev Innovation Summit and Front Conference, and a mentor to engineers who now lead features on their own.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Lead technical discovery through production for a global AI-native SaaS: agent architecture, POCs, integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo via REST + webhooks + OAuth, and MCP tool servers exposed to end users. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M/quarter forecast revenue.

Serve as the technical escalation point when integrations break: reproduce, root-cause, fix, and write the postmortem. Own eval pipelines (LangSmith), cost telemetry, and on-call for global production.
Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying 5+ enterprise silos into one time-aware source. Architectural decision shaped by real deployment learnings, not theory.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of Incubation, reporting to CIO. Ran planning, scoping, and delivery of a complex multi-quarter implementation. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house Python + OpenAI pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Full scope: diagnose the recurring spend, build the integration, ship with instrumentation, kill the contract.

Ran observability and on-call for global production (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io) across Python, Java, TypeScript, Vue services on Kubernetes. Reproduced and diagnosed customer-facing issues, built the fix, documented the playbook.

Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Grew engineers who now lead features independently. Co-owned GTM launches with Sales, PM, and Customer Success with instrumentation to know within a week if they moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions. Structured, data-driven feedback to investment committees.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading; advised founders on integrations, delivery playbooks, and building engineering teams that ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for EPFL spin-off drone delivery. Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) powering 500+ real-world deliveries. Enterprise-grade integrations enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Owned the full client-facing implementation as single accountable owner: architecture, integrations, on-call, and the customer conversations behind them.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax platform for Swiss-Indian families in a heavily regulated domain (DTAA, FEMA, Swiss tax). Ran discovery with real users, built RAG-grounded assistant with citations back to source regulation. Compliance-first design in a regulated industry, same discipline required to ship in insurance. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence platform for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals with explainability built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Auditability is the whole product.
